hero.subheadlineEn: Miftaxul Quran Online is an online school that makes learning the Quran easy. We offer live classes, experienced teachers, and flexible schedules.

heroSlides.hadithAr: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
heroSlides.hadithSo:
Rasuulka Alle ﷺ wuxuu yiri:
“Kan idiinku kheyr badan waa kan Qur’aanka barta oo dadka bara.”
heroSlides.hadithEn:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“The best of you are those who learn the Qur’an and teach it.”

heroSlides.hadithAr:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:
اقْرَؤُوا الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ.
heroSlides.hadithSo:
Rasuulka Alle ﷺ wuxuu yiri:
“Akhriya Qur’aanka, waayo wuxuu iman doonaa Maalinta Qiyaamaha isagoo u shafeecaya kuwa la saaxiibay.”
heroSlides.hadithEn:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“Recite the Qur’an, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection and intercede for its companions.”

heroSlides.hadithAr:
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:
مَنْ قَرَأَ حَرْفًا مِنْ كِتَابِ اللهِ فَلَهُ بِهِ حَسَنَةٌ، وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا.
heroSlides.hadithSo:
Rasuulka Alle ﷺ wuxuu yiri:
“Qofkii akhriya hal xaraf oo ka mid ah Kitaabka Alle wuxuu leeyahay hal xasanaad, xasanaaddana toban jeer ayaa loo laalaabaa.”
heroSlides.hadithEn:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah will have one good deed, and each good deed is multiplied by ten.”

aboutPageContent.heroTitleSo: Dugsiga MiftaxulQuran waa Dugsi heer Caalami ah!
aboutPageContent.heroTitleEn: MiftaxulQuran is An International-Level Qur’an Madrasa!
aboutPageContent.heroSubtitleSo: "MiftaxulQuran"  ujeedada ugu weyn ee loo aasaasay waa: fidinta Diinta islaamka iyo in uu fure u noqdo Muslimiin badan oo raba in ay diinta bartaan basle ku mashquulsan shaqooyin gaar u ah, ama aan helikarin dugsi ka bartaan qur'aanka kariimka ah.
aboutPageContent.heroSubtitleEn: The primary purpose of establishing MiftaxulQuran is to spread the teachings of Islam and provide an accessible gateway for Muslims who wish to learn their religion but are unable to attend a Qur’an school due to work commitments, busy schedules, or limited access to suitable Qur’an education.
aboutPageContent.ourStoryContentSo: "Dugsiga Miftaxulquran waa dugsi Online ah, waxaana la aasaasay 2016, Waxaa uu dugsigu fududeeyey barashada Diinta islaamka oo ugu horeeyo Qur'aanka kariimka, yooka Dugsiga Miftaxulquran waaa Fidinta Diinta islaamka. Hadda waxaan haynaa in ka badan 50+ oo arday oo ku sugan dinida dacaladeeda.
aboutPageContent.ourStoryContentEn: MiftaxulQuran is an online Islamic school established in 2016 to make Islamic education, particularly the learning of the Holy Qur’an, more accessible to students around the world. Our mission is to contribute to the spread of Islamic knowledge and make authentic religious education accessible to Muslims wherever they are. Today, we are proud to serve more than 50+ students across different parts of the world.
aboutPageContent.missionDescriptionSo: Dugsiga MiftaxulQuran Online wuxuu u taagan yahay faafinta iyo baridda cilmiga diinta Islaamka. Waxaa loo aasaasay himilo ah in waxbarasho diimeed oo sax ah, tayo leh, oo nidaamsan ay heli karaan qoys kasta oo Muslim ah, meel kasta oo ay dunida ka joogaan. Waxaana heegan kuu ah macallimiin aqoon, khibrad iyo Ijaazah la hubo leh, kuwaas oo waxbarashadoodu ku salaysan tahay silsilad cilmiyeed la hubiyey oo ku xiran Rasuulkeenna Muxammad ﷺ.
aboutPageContent.missionDescriptionEn: MiftaxulQuran Online is dedicated to spreading and teaching the knowledge of Islam. It was established with the vision of making authentic, high-quality, and structured Islamic education accessible to every Muslim family, wherever they are in the world. You will have access to qualified and experienced teachers who hold verified Ijazah, with their teaching grounded in an authenticated chain of Islamic scholarship connected to our beloved Messenger, Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
aboutPageContent.visionDescriptionSo: Himiladeennu waa in waxbarasho diimeed oo sax ah, tayo leh, oo nidaamsan ay si fudud u heli karaan qoys kasta oo Muslim ah, meel kasta oo ay dunida ka joogaan.
aboutPageContent.visionDescriptionEn: Our vision is to make authentic, high-quality, and structured Islamic education easily accessible to every Muslim family, wherever they are in the world.
